inputs.reason: Moho 14.5 Live Mode input identifiers have not been discovered yet (docs/live-models.md); no names are invented

relaxed_standing.why: relaxed hands, neutral wrists; a hanging arm shows the back or the edge of the hand

walking.why: relaxed or partially closed hands; no pointing or thumbs-up while walking

running.why: loose fists or relaxed hands, the same on both arms, no wrist twist

pointing.why: pointing hand, index toward the target (arm IK reaches, the wrist aims)

shrugging.why: expressive shrug: palms up (an open palm-up drawing; a cupped palm-up drawing as an approximation)

shrug_subtle.why: subtle shrug: hands low, palms turned toward the camera or edge-on

explaining.why: open or cupped hands, varied between beats

hand_on_desk.why: hand resting on the desk top: palm down (seen from above) preferred

angry.why: fists; pointing only when the action has a target

gripping.why: grip hand on the interaction target

thumbs_up.why: thumbs-up, thumb turned to read upward

hand_on_hip.why: relaxed or cupped hands on the hips, no extreme rotation
